advanced-filter-description: Mā te Tātari Arā Atu Anō ka taea te tuhi aho whai i ēnei pūwhakahaere: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ka whakamahia he mokowā hei whakawehe i ngā Pūwhakahaere. Ka taea te tātari i ngā Āpure Ritenga katoa mā te pato i ō rātou ingoa me ngā uara. Hei Tauira: Field1 == Value1. Tuhipoka: Ki te whai mokowā ngā āpure, ngā uara rānei, me whakakapi ki ngā tohukī takitahi. Hei Tauira: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Hei peke i ngā pūāhua whakahaere takitahi (' \/), whakamahia \. Hei tauira: Field1 == I\'m. Ka taea hoki te whakakotahi i ngā here maha. Hei Tauira: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ko te tikanga ka whakamāramatia ngā pūwhakahaere katoa mai i mauī ki matau. Ka taea te huri i te raupapa mā te whakamahi taiapa. Hei Tauira: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ka taea hoki te rapu āpure kuputuhi mā te regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON kaweake Kanboard: he ahanoa whai "columns" (he tūmahi rānei whai column_name) me tētahi huānga "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Ka noho ngā tīwae hei rārangi, ā, ngā tūmahi hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-deck: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON papa NextCloud Deck (he papa whai "stacks", ā, kei ia stack āna "cards"). Ka noho ngā stacks hei rārangi, ā, ngā cards hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON kohinga mōkī-mahi OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Ka noho ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ā, ngā mōkī mahi hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-issues: Whakapiri i tētahi huānga JSON take __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ka noho ngā take hei kāri kua whakarōpūhia ki ngā rārangi Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON kaweake tūmahi Asana ({ "data": [...] } mai i te kaweake Asana, GET /tasks rānei). Ka whakarōpūhia ngā tūmahi ki ngā wāhanga (memberships); ka haere ngā tūmahi kua oti ki Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON kaweake rārangi ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Ka noho ngā stages hei rārangi, ā, ngā items hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Whakapiritia he rārangi mahi markdown (te tikanga e whakamahia ana e ngā taputapu markdown-kanban pēnei i te Obsidian Kanban): ngā pane "## Ingoa rārangi", me ngā tūemi "- [ ]"/"- [x]" kei raro. Ka huri ngā pane hei rārangi, ka huri ngā tūemi hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-leo: Whakapiria he hanganga Leo (he kōnae .leo). Ka huri ngā wāhanga o te taumata runga rawa hei rārangi, ā, ko ngā wāhanga kei raro tonu i aua wāhanga ka huri hei kāri, me te tuhinga o te wāhanga hei whakaahuatanga. Ka huri ngā wāhanga o ngā taumata hōhonu ake hei rārangi arowhai. Ka kawemai ngā wāhanga kua tohua hei mea kua oti.
import-board-instruction-opml: Whakapiri i tētahi whakahuahua OPML, pērā i tā Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq me ētahi atu kaiwhakahuahua e kaweatu ai. Ka huri ngā tūemi taumata-runga hei rārangi, ka huri ā rātou tamariki hei kāri me te tuhipoka hei whakaahuatanga, ā, ka huri ngā tūemi hōhonu ake hei rārangi arowhai. Ka kawemai ngā tūemi kua oti hei mea kua oti.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Whakapiri i tētahi kōnae Org mode, pērā i tā Emacs, Orgzly, Beorg rānei e tuhi ai. Ka huri ngā upoko taumata-runga hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā upoko taumata tuarua hei kāri. Ka puritia a TODO me DONE, ngā matatau, ngā tūtohu, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE me CLOSED, ā, ka huri ngā pouaka tohu me ngā upoko hōhonu ake hei rārangi arowhai.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Whakapirihia he kōnae todo.txt: kotahi te mahi ki ia rārangi, pēnei i te tuhi a te taupānga todo.txt me ngā taupānga hototahi. Ka haere ngā mahi kua oti ("x") ki te wāhanga Kua oti, ka huri a +project me @context hei tapanga, ka huri a (A) hei tapanga whakaarotau, ā, ka huri a due: me t: hei rā kati, hei rā tīmata hoki.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Whakapirihia te putanga o task export: he mahere huānga JSON, he tūmahi kotahi rānei ki ia rārangi. Ka haere ngā tūmahi kua oti ki Done, ka huri a project me priority hei tapanga, a annotations hei kōrero, ā, a depends hei hononga whakawhirinaki ki ngā tūmahi e ārai ana.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Wewetehia te kōnae .boardarchive, ā, whakapirihia ngā ihirangi o te board.jsonl o te papa, me te rārangi putanga, me te kore rānei. Ka huri te āhuatanga whakarōpū o te tirohanga papa hei rārangi, ngā āhuatanga kōwhiri kē hei tapanga, ngā poraka kuputuhi me ngā pouakataki hei whakaahuatanga me te rārangi arowhai, ā, ka puritia ngā kōrero. Kāore ngā atahanga me ngā āpitihanga e kawemai.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: I Azure DevOps, whakatuwheratia a Boards, kātahi ko Queries, whakahaerehia he uiui e whakaatu ana i ngā tīwae e hiahia ana koe, ka kōwhiri i Export to CSV; kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .csv. Ka noho a Board Column (State rānei) hei rārangi, ā, a Board Lane hei ara; ka noho ngā tūemi mahi hei kāri, me ō rātou momo me ngā tags hei tapanga, Assigned To, ngā rā, te whakaahuatanga me te mātua, ā, ka noho ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-mslists: I Microsoft Lists, whakatuwheratia te rārangi, kōwhiria a Export, kātahi ko Export to CSV, ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .csv. Ka noho te tīwae Status (Progress rānei) hei rārangi, ā, ia tūemi hei kāri, me tōna taitara, whakaahuatanga, tāngata, rā me ngā tags; ka noho ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-msproject: I Microsoft Project, kōwhiria a File, kātahi ko Save As, me te momo XML Format (*.xml), ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae. Ka noho ngā tūmahi whakarāpopoto hei ara, ā, ngā tūmahi hei kāri i Not started, In progress, Completed rānei, me ō rātou rā, tuhipoka, rauemi, tūmahi-iti me ngā tūmahi o mua.
import-board-instruction-outlook: I Outlook, tōia ngā karere ki tētahi kōpaki i tō rorohiko, ki te penapena rānei mā File, kātahi ko Save As, hei Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Kōwhiria kotahi kōnae .msg, he .zip rānei o ngā kōnae .msg me .eml. Ka noho ia kōrerorero hei kāri i Board View / Email, ko ōna whakautu hei kōrero, ko ōna tāpiritanga hei kōnae.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: I MeisterTask, pāwhiri i te ingoa kaupapa, kōwhiria Export project, kaweatu i te CSV, kātahi ka whakapiri. Ka huri ngā wāhanga hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ā rātou tuhipoka, rā tika, kaiwhiwhi mahi me ngā tūtohu; ka pupuri ngā tūmahi kua oti i tō rātou rā i oti ai. Ka mahi hoki tētahi CSV i tuhia mō te kawemai ake a MeisterTask.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: I Obsidian, huakina te kōnae o te papa Kanban hei Markdown (huakina rānei te kōnae .md ki tētahi ētita kuputuhi), kātahi ka whakapiri katoa. Ka huri ngā ara hei rārangi me ō rātou tepe kāri, ka pupuri ngā kāri i ā rātou tūtohu, rā, matatau, āpure me te rārangi arowhai, ā, ka huri te Archive hei kāri kua pūrangatia.
import-board-instruction-linear: I Linear, kaweatu i ngā take hei CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, te kaweatu rānei o tētahi tirohanga), kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka huri ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ka huri ngā tīma hei ara, ā, ka huri ngā take hei kāri me ō rātou kaiwhiwhi mahi, tapanga, rā, take matua, matatau, whakatau tata, kaupapa me te huringa.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: I TickTick, huakina Settings, Account, Backup & Import, ka hanga i tētahi tārua, kātahi ka whakapiri i te kōnae CSV. Ka huri ia rārangi TickTick hei ara, ā, ka huri ōna tīwae hei rārangi; ka pupuri ngā tūmahi i ā rātou tūtohu, rā, rārangi arowhai, matatau me ngā tūmahi-iti.
import-board-instruction-clickup: I ClickUp, kaweatu i ngā tūmahi hei CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, te kaweatu rānei o tētahi tirohanga List, Table rānei me ngā tīwae katoa), kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka huri ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ka huri ngā rārangi ClickUp hei ara, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri me ō rātou tūmahi-iti, kaiwhiwhi mahi, tūtohu, rā, matatau me te wā.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: I Nullboard, huakina te papa, kōwhiria Export this board... i te tahua, huakina te kōnae .nbx ki tētahi ētita kuputuhi, ka whakapiri i ōna ihirangi. Ka huri ngā rārangi hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tuhipoka hei kāri: ko te rārangi tuatahi o tētahi tuhipoka te taitara kāri, ko te toenga tōna whakaahuatanga. Ka whiwhi tētahi tuhipoka raw i te tapanga raw. Ka kawemai tētahi kōnae he maha ōna papa i tōna papa tuatahi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: I Kanri, huakina Import & Export, kōwhiria Export individual board (Export all data rānei), kātahi ka whakapiri i te kōnae .json. Ka huri ngā tīwae hei rārangi, ā, ka noho ngā kāri hei kāri, me ō rātou whakaahuatanga, rā tika, tūtohu me ngā tae; ka huri ngā tūmahi o tētahi kāri hei rārangi arowhai. Mai i tētahi kaweatu raraunga katoa ka kawemai te papa tuatahi.
import-board-instruction-planka: Patohia te wāhitau o tō Planka (hei tauira https://planka.example.com), tō ingoa kaiwhakamahi me tō kupuhipa Planka, kātahi pēhia «Whakaatuhia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai». Ka whakamahia ēnei hei tiki i te poari anake, ā, kāore e penapenatia. Kōwhiria he poari ka pēhi i «Tikina»: ka pānuitia e WeKan mai i te API o Planka me ōna rārangi, kāri, whakaahuatanga, rā tika, tapanga, mema, rārangi mahi me ngā kōrero, kātahi haere tonu te kawemai pēnā i mua. Ka kawemaihia ngā kāri kei te pūranga o Planka hei kāri kua purangatia; kāore e kawemaihia ngā āpitihanga me ngā kāri kei te ipupara.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: I Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), takiuru, whakaaetia te whakaaetanga Tasks.Read ka tārua i te tohu mai i te ripa Access token. Whakapirihia ki konei ka pāwhiri «Whakaatuhia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai»; ka whakamahia te tohu mō tēnei tikinga anake, ā, kāore e penapenatia. Kōwhiria ngā rārangi katoa, he rārangi kotahi rānei, ka pāwhiri «Tikina». Ka huri ia rārangi To Do hei rārangi, ā, ia mahi hei kāri, me ōna tuhipoka, rā tika me te rā tīmata, ngā hipanga hei rārangi arowhai, ngā kāwai hei tapanga, te hiranga nui me te tūnga hei tapanga; ka purangatia ngā mahi kua oti. Kāore e kawemaihia ngā whakamaumahara me ngā tukurua.
import-board-instruction-onenote: I Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), takiuru, whakaae ki te whakaaetanga Notes.Read ka tārua i te tohu mai i te ripa Access token. Whakapirihia ki konei ka pāwhiri i «Whakaaturia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai»; ka whakamahia te tohu mō tēnei tiki anake, ā, kāore e penapenatia. Kōwhiria he pukatuhi ka pāwhiri i «Tikina». Ka noho ngā wāhanga hei rārangi, ā, ngā whārangi hei kāri, me ō rātou kuputuhi, ngā pouaka mahi hei rārangi arowhai me ngā whārangi-iti hei tūmahi-iti.
import-board-instruction-teams: Whakapirihia he tohu urunga Microsoft Graph me Chat.Read (mai i Graph Explorer, he pūkete mahi, kura rānei) ka pāwhiri i «Whakaaturia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai», kātahi ka kōwhiri i tētahi kōrerorero, hongere rānei ka pāwhiri i «Tikina»; kāore te tohu e penapenatia. Kōwhiria rānei he kōnae: te .tar o tō kaweake whaiaro mai i teams.live.com/dataexport, he .json rānei o ngā karere kōrerorero. Ka noho ia kōrerorero hei kāri i Board View / Chat, ko ōna karere hei kōrero.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: I Sandstorm, whakatuwherahia te grain __app__, kōwhiria "Download backup" i te pae o runga o te grain, ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .zip. Ka noho te ihirangi o te grain hei papa, ōna mea hei kāri me ngā mea e puritia ana e te taupānga mō rātou. Kōwhiria te taupānga nō reira te grain: ka whakakāhoretia te grain o tētahi atu taupānga, ā, ka kīia ko tēhea taupānga.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: I KanbanFlow, huakina te tahua o te poari, kōwhiria Settings → API & Webhooks ka tārua i te tohu API o te poari. Whakapirihia te tohu ki konei, pāwhiria «Whakaatuhia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai», kōwhiria te poari ka pāwhiri «Tikina»; ka whakamahia te tohu mō taua tikinga anake, ā, kāore e penapenatia. Ka huri ngā tīwae hei rārangi, ā, ka noho tonu ngā ara hei ara; ka mau tonu i ngā mahi tō rātou whakaahuatanga, tae, tapanga, rā tika, mahi iti hei rārangi arowhai, wā i pau, whakatau tata, tāngata me ngā kōrero.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Patohia tō ID pūkete Basecamp (te nama i muri i basecamp.com/ i te wāhitau) me tētahi tohu urunga (mai i tētahi taupānga OAuth 2 kua rēhitatia ki launchpad.37signals.com, tētahi rānei kei tētahi whakaurunga kē), pāwhiria «Whakaatuhia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai», kōwhiria he kaupapa ka pāwhiri «Tikina». Ka whakamahia te tohu mō taua tikinga anake, ā, kāore e penapenatia. Ka huri ia ripanga kāri hei ara me ōna tīwae hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā rārangi mahi hei ara «To-dos»; ka mau tonu i ngā kāri me ngā mahi ō rātou kuputuhi, rā, kaiwhakaritea me ngā kōrero, ka huri ngā hipanga o te kāri hei rārangi arowhai, ā, ka purangatia ngā mahi kua oti.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Tikina he tohu urunga mai i te OAuth 2.0 Playground: i raro i Tasks API v1 kōwhiria tasks.readonly, pāwhiria Authorize APIs, kātahi Exchange authorization code for tokens, ka tārua i te tohu urunga. Whakapirihia ki konei ka pāwhiri «Whakaatuhia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai», kōwhiria ngā rārangi mahi katoa, kotahi rānei, kātahi «Tikina». Ka whakamahia te tohu mō tēnei tikinga anake, ā, kāore e penapenatia. Ka huri ngā rārangi mahi hei rārangi, ā, ngā mahi hei kāri, me ō rātou tuhipoka, hononga me te rā tika; ka huri ngā mahi iti hei rārangi arowhai, ā, ka kawemaihia ngā mahi kua oti hei mea kua purangatia.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Mō ngā pūkete Google Workspace anake te API o Google Keep. Tikina he tohu urunga OAuth 2.0 me te whānuitanga https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (i te OAuth 2.0 Playground mēnā ka whakaaetia e tō kaiwhakahaere Workspace, mai rānei i tētahi pūkete ratonga me te tukunga puta noa i te rohe), whakapirihia, pāwhiria «Whakaatuhia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai», kātahi «Tikina». Ka whakamahia te tohu mō tēnei tikinga anake, ā, kāore e penapenatia. Ka huri ngā tuhipoka kuputuhi hei kāri i te rārangi «Notes», ā, ka huri ngā tuhipoka rārangi arowhai hei kāri i te rārangi «Lists» me ō rātou tūemi hei rārangi arowhai. Kāore e kawemaihia ngā tuhipoka kei te ipupara, ngā āpitihanga me te tiritiri.
api-import-desc: Tikina mai i te ratonga mā tō ake pūkete. Ka whakamahia ō tuhinga ki konei mō tēnei tikinga anake, ā, kāore e penapenatia.
api-import-list: Whakaatuhia ngā mea ka taea te kawemai
api-import-fetched: Kua tikina. Tirohia ngā mema i raro ka kawemai.
api-import-nothing: Kāore he mea hei kawemai mā tēnei pūkete.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: I Pivotal Tracker, huakina te ripa MORE o te kaupapa, kōwhiria Export CSV (kōwhiria rānei ngā kōrero, ka kōwhiri Bulk Actions, CSV), kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka huri ia tūnga kōrero hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā kōrero hei kāri, me ō rātou momo me ngā tapanga, kaipupuri, kaitono, rā, kōrero, tūmahi me ngā ārai; ka huri a Estimate hei Story points, ā, ka huri ngā huringa hei sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: I Tasks.org, huakina Settings, Backups, kōwhiria Export tasks, kātahi ka whakapiri i ngā ihirangi o taua kōnae .json. Ka huri ngā rārangi hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ā rātou tuhipoka, tūtohu, rā, kōrero me ngā tūmahi-iti; ka pupuri ngā tūmahi kua oti i tō rātou rā i oti ai, ā, ka huri te matatau hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-monday: I monday.com, huakina te tahua papa, kōwhiria More actions me Export board to Excel (me ngā whakahou me ngā tūemi-iti mēnā ka pai koe), kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .xlsx. Ka huri te tīwae Status hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā rōpū hei ara; ka noho ngā tāngata, rā, rārangi wā me ngā tūtohu ki ō rātou wāhi, ka huri ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga, ā, ka huri ngā whakahou hei kōrero.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: I Super Productivity, huakina Settings, kātahi Sync & Backup, kōwhiria Export Data, ka whakapiri i ngā ihirangi o te kōnae sp-backup .json. Ka huri ia kaupapa hei ara, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri i To Do, In Progress, Backlog, Done rānei, me ā rātou tuhipoka, tūtohu, rā tika, wā i pau me ngā tūmahi-iti; ka huri ngā tūmahi kua pūrangatia hei kāri kua pūrangatia.
import-board-instruction-taiga: I Taiga, huakina Admin > Project > Export, ka tikiake i te putunga kaupapa (wetekina tētahi kōnae .json.gz i te tuatahi), kātahi ka whakapiri i tōna JSON. Ka huri ngā tūnga user story hei rārangi, ka huri ngā user story hei kāri me ā rātou tūmahi hei tūmahi-iti, ka whiwhi ngā epic me ngā take i ō rātou ake ara, ā, ka haere tahi mai ngā sprint, tūtohu, kōrero me ngā āhuatanga ritenga. Kāore e kawemaitia ngā āpitihanga.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: I Vikunja, huakina Settings, kōwhiria Data Export, ka tikiake i te kōnae .zip ka tukuna mai ki a koe, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae, whakapiri rānei i te data.json kei roto. Ka huri ngā peere Kanban hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ō rātou tapanga, kaiwhiwhi mahi, rā, whakaahuatanga, rārangi tūmahi hei rārangi arowhai me ngā kōrero; ka huri te matatau, te ōrau kua oti me te kua oti hei āpure ritenga. Kāore e kawemaitia ngā āpitihanga.
import-board-instruction-quire: I Quire, huakina te tahua kaupapa, kōwhiria Export CSV, kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka huri ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ō rātou tūmahi-iti hei kāri tamaiti, kaiwhiwhi mahi, tūtohu hei tapanga, rā tīmata, rā tika, rā oti, whakaahuatanga me te matatau hei āpure ritenga. Kāore ngā kōrero me ngā āpitihanga i roto i te CSV a Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: I Wrike, kaweatu i tētahi kaupapa, kōpaki rānei ki Excel, whakakīia rānei te tauira kawemai Excel a Wrike, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .xlsx. Ka huri ngā rārangi kōpaki me ngā kaupapa hei ara, ka huri a Status hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ō rātou Key, tūmahi matua, kaiwhiwhi mahi, rā tīmata me te rā mutunga, ngā whakawhirinakitanga me te whakaahuatanga; ka huri a Priority, Duration me ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: I Teamwork.com, whakakīia te tauira kawemai tūmahi Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status), tiakina hei .xlsx, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae. Ka huri ngā rārangi tūmahi hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri; ko tētahi tūmahi ka tīmata ki te -, # rānei, > rānei ka huri hei tūmahi-iti o te tūmahi kei runga ake (--, ## rānei, >> rānei kotahi te taumata hōhonu ake). Ka noho ngā kaiwhiwhi mahi, rā me ngā tūtohu ki ō rātou wāhi; ka huri a Priority, Estimated time me Complete hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: I Businessmap (ko Kanbanize i mua), huakina Advanced Search, kōwhiria Configure results hei kōwhiri i ngā tīwae, tikiake i te kōnae Excel, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .xlsx. Ka pānuitia ngā tīwae mā ō rātou ingoa Ingarihi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): mēnā he reo kē tō pūkete, whakaingoatia anōtia te rārangi upoko ki te reo Ingarihi i te tuatahi. Ka huri a Column hei rārangi, a Lane hei ara; ka noho ngā kaipupuri, tūtohu, tae, rā, kōrero me ngā hononga matua ki ō rātou wāhi, ā, ka huri a Priority, Size, Type me ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-redmine: I Redmine, huakina ngā Issues o te kaupapa, kōwhiria Also available in: CSV i raro o te rārangi, kōwhiria ngā tīwae (All columns, me Description), ka kaweatu, kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka tapaina e Redmine ngā tīwae ki tō reo, nō reira whakaritea tō reo ki te Ingarihi i My account i mua i te kaweatu. Ka huri ia tūnga hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā take hei kāri, me te tracker hei tapanga, kaiwhiwhi mahi, kaituhi, rā, tūmahi matua me ngā take hāngai; ka huri te matatau, te kāwai, te putanga whāinga, te wā i whakatau tatahia, % Done me ngā āpure ritenga hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-notion: I Notion, huakina te pātengi raraunga hei whārangi katoa, kōwhiria ••• me Export, kōwhiria Markdown & CSV, ka kōwhiri i te kōnae .zip ka tikiakehia, i tētahi CSV pātengi raraunga rānei o roto, whakapiri rānei i taua CSV. Ko tētahi tīwae ko Status te ingoa ka huri hei rārangi (ki te kore, ko te tīwae tuatahi e rite ana ki te select, ā, ka kī te pūrongo kawemai ko tēhea); ka huri ngā rārangi hei kāri me ō rātou taitara, tūtohu hei tapanga, tāngata hei mema, rā, me te kuputuhi whārangi hei whakaahuatanga; ka huri ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga. Kāore e kawemaitia ngā hononga, ngā whakaahua me ngā āpitihanga.
import-board-instruction-plane: I Plane, huakina Workspace Settings, kōwhiria Exports, kaweatu i ngā kaupapa hei JSON, CSV, Excel rānei, ka tikiake i te kōnae .zip, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae, i tētahi kōnae rānei o roto, whakapiri rānei i te JSON, CSV rānei. Ka huri ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ka huri ngā kaupapa hei ara, ā, ka huri ngā take hei kāri me ō rātou tautuhi, matua, kaiwhiwhi mahi, tapanga, rā, hononga me ngā kōrero; ka huri te matatau, te whakatau tata, te huringa me te kōwae hei āpure ritenga. Kāore he whakaahuatanga, āpitihanga rānei i te kaweatu a Plane, nō reira kāore e kawemaitia.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: I Fizzy, kaweatu te pūkete i "Account settings", ō kāri rānei mā "Download my data", ka kōwhiri i te kōnae .zip ka tukuna mai e Fizzy, i te kōnae .json rānei o tētahi kāri. Ka noho ngā papa hei ara, ka noho ngā tīwae hei rārangi, me "Maybe?", "Not now" me "Done" pērā i Fizzy; ka puritia e ngā kāri tō rātou whakaahuatanga, ngā tapanga, ngā kaiwhiwhi mahi, ngā hipanga hei rārangi arowhai, ngā kōrero me ngā kōnae.
import-board-instruction-mail: Kōwhiria he kōnae .mbox, pērā i tā Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt, Gmail rānei mā Google Takeout e tiaki ai, he karere .eml kotahi rānei, me whakapiri rānei tōna kuputuhi. Ka noho ia kōrerorero hei kāri kotahi i te rārangi Inbox, me tōna kaituku, ōna kaiwhiwhi me tōna kaupapa, kia kitea ai i te tirohanga Email; ka noho ngā whakautu hei kōrero mōna. Ka noho ngā tapanga Gmail hei tapanga. Kāore ngā āpitihanga e kawemaitia.
import-board-instruction-ical: Kōwhiria he kōnae maramataka .ics, pērā i tā Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Reminders rānei, Thunderbird, Nextcloud, Outlook rānei e kaweatu ai, me whakapiri rānei tōna kuputuhi. Ka haere ngā mahi ki To Do, In Progress, Done, Cancelled rānei, i runga i tō rātou tūnga, ā, ngā takahanga ki Events, me ō rātou rā tīmata me ō rātou rā tika, kia kitea ai i ngā tirohanga Calendar me Gantt. Ka noho ngā kāwai me te hiranga hei tapanga. Kotahi noa te kawemaitanga o ngā tūemi tāruarua.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: I takeout.google.com, kōwhiria Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar me Google Chat, hangaia te kaweatu ka tikiake i te kōnae .zip, kātahi ka kōwhiri i konei. Ka noho ia hua hei ara: ngā īmēra mō te tirohanga Email, ngā rārangi mahi me ngā tuhipoka me ō rātou rārangi arowhai, ngā takahanga maramataka me ngā mahi me ō rātou rā, me ngā wāhi kōrero ko ō rātou karere he kōrero mō te tirohanga Chat. Kāore ētahi atu hua me ngā āpitihanga e kawemaitia.
import-board-instruction-slack: I Slack, huakina ngā tautuhinga o te wāhi mahi, kōwhiria Import/Export Data, kaweatu te wāhi mahi ka tikiake i te kōnae .zip, kātahi ka kōwhiri i konei. Ka noho ia hongere hei kāri i Channels, Groups, Direct messages rānei, ā, ka noho ōna karere me ngā whakautu miro hei kōrero mō te kāri, i runga i tō rātou kaituhi, kia whakaaturia ai te hongere e te tirohanga Chat. Kāore ngā kōnae e kawemaitia.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Kaweatu mā mmctl export create, tikiake i te kaweatu ka kōwhiri i tōna kōnae .jsonl, me whakapiri rānei tōna kuputuhi. Ka noho ia hongere me ia karere tōtika hei kāri, ā, ka noho ōna pānui me ngā whakautu hei kōrero mō te kāri, kia whakaaturia ai te hongere e te tirohanga Chat. Ka noho ngā rōpū hei ara. Kāore ngā kōnae e kawemaitia.
import-board-instruction-telegram: I Telegram Desktop, huakina Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, kōwhiria te hōputu JSON ka kaweatu, kātahi ka kōwhiri i te kōnae result.json, me whakapiri rānei tōna kuputuhi. Ka noho ia kōrerorero hei kāri i Direct messages, Groups, Channels rānei, ā, ka noho ōna karere hei kōrero mō te kāri, kia whakaaturia ai te kōrerorero e te tirohanga Chat. Kāore ngā whakaahua me ngā kōnae e kawemaitia.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: I WhatsApp, huakina te kōrerorero, kōwhiria Export chat kāore he pāpāho, ka kōwhiri i te kōnae .txt i konei, me whakapiri rānei tōna kuputuhi. Ka noho te kōrerorero hei kāri, ko ōna karere ōna kōrero, i runga i te kaituku me te wā, kia whakaaturia ai e te tirohanga Chat. Kāore ngā pāpāho me ngā karere pūnaha e kawemaitia.
import-board-instruction-discord: Kaweatu i tētahi hongere Discord mā DiscordChatExporter i te hōputu JSON ka kōwhiri i te kōnae .json, me whakapiri rānei tōna kuputuhi. globalSearch-instructions-description: Ka taea e ngā rapunga te whai pūwhakahaere hei whakamahine i te rapu. Ka tohua ngā pūwhakahaere mā te tuhi i te ingoa pūwhakahaere me te uara kua wehea e te kopirua. Hei tauira, mā te whakatakotoranga `list:Blocked` ka whakawhāiti te rapu ki ngā kāri kei roto i tētahi rārangi ko *Blocked* te ingoa. Ki te whai mokowā, pūāhua motuhake rānei te uara, me whakakapi ki ngā tohukī (hei tauira `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - ngā kāri i ngā papa e ōrite ana ki te *<title>* kua tohua
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - ngā kāri i ngā rārangi e ōrite ana ki te *<title>* kua tohua
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - ngā kāri i ngā kauhanga e ōrite ana ki te *<title>* kua tohua
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - ngā kāri whai tākupu kei roto te *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - ngā kāri whai tapanga e ōrite ana ki te *<color>*, ki te *<name>* rānei
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - ngā kāri he *mema*, he *kaiwhiwhi* rānei a *<username>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - ngā kāri nō tētahi papa kua tautapatia ki te whakahaere *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - ngā kāri nō tētahi papa kua tautapatia ki te tīma *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - ngā kāri ka tika i roto i ngā rā *<n>* mai i nāianei. Ka whakarārangi a `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ i ngā kāri katoa kua hipa te rā tika.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - ngā kāri i waihangatia i ngā rā *<n>* kua hipa, iti iho rānei
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - ngā kāri i whakarerekētia i ngā rā *<n>* kua hipa, iti iho rānei
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - ngā kāri katoa kua pūrangatia, kāore anō rānei kia pūrangatia
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - ngā kāri i ngā papa tūmatanui anake
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - ngā kāri i ngā papa tūmataiti anake
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - ko te *<field>* tētahi o `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__`, `__predicate_member__` rānei. Mā te tuku `-` ki mua o *<field>* ka rapu i te korenga o tētahi uara i taua āpure (hei tauira, ka rapu a `has:-due` i ngā kāri kāore he rā tika).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - ko te *<sort-name>* tētahi o `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__`, `__predicate_modified__` rānei. Mō te kōmaka heke, hoatu he `-` ki mua o te ingoa kōmaka.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - ko te *<n>* he tau tōpū tōrunga e whakaatu ana i te maha o ngā kāri ki ia whārangi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Ka taea te tohu pūwhakahaere maha.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ka honoa ngā pūwhakahaere ōrite mā te *OR*. Ka whakahokia ngā kāri e ōrite ana ki tētahi here.
Mā `__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` ka whakahoki ngā kāri kei roto i tētahi rārangi ko *Blocked*, ko *Available* rānei te ingoa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ka honoa ngā pūwhakahaere rerekē mā te *AND*. Ko ngā kāri anake e ōrite ana ki ngā pūwhakahaere rerekē katoa ka whakahokia. Mā `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` ka whakahoki anake ngā kāri i te rārangi *Available* whai tapanga *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Ka taea te tohu rā hei tau tōpū tōrunga, tōraro rānei, mā `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__`, `__predicate_year__` rānei mō te wā o nāianei.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Kāore ngā rapu kuputuhi e aro ki te pūmatua, pūriki rānei.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Kāore ngā kāri kua pūrangatia e rapua taunoatia.

database-migration-description: Hekehia ngā raraunga ā-kuputuhi (ngā mea katoa hāunga ngā āpitihanga me ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, ka noho ki te pūnaha kōnae) i waenga i MongoDB me FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Me whakahaere, me taea hoki te toro atu ki tērā atu pātengi raraunga (ngā tauranga taunoa: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; whakakapia mā WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ina oti, tohuhia a MONGO_URL ki tērā atu pātengi raraunga, ka tīmata anō i WeKan (ki Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb, =mongodb rānei).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Heke raraunga kuputuhi ki FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Tāruatia ngā kohinga ā-kuputuhi katoa ki __db__? Kāore ngā āpitihanga me ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi i te pūnaha kōnae e pāngia. Me whakahaere te pātengi raraunga ūnga.
sandstorm-migration-description: Ina rere a WeKan i roto i tētahi kākano Sandstorm, ka heke tōna pātengi raraunga MongoDB 3 tawhito ki FerretDB v1 (SQLite) i te whakarewatanga tuatahi, ā, ka nekehia ngā āpitihanga me ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi mai i te pātengi raraunga ki ngā whaiaronga files/attachments me files/avatars o te kākano. Ka whakaatu tēnei mēnā i angitu taua hekenga, e hia hoki te mokowā kōpae e whakamahia tonutia ana e ngā kōnae pātengi raraunga MongoDB mata tawhito i roto i te kākano, ā, ka āhei koe ki te muku i aua kōnae mata hei whakawātea mokowā.

sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Muku kōnae pātengi raraunga MongoDB mata
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Whai muri i tētahi hekenga angitu, kei FerretDB me te pūnaha kōnae ngā raraunga, nō reira ka taea te muku i ngā kōnae pātengi raraunga MongoDB 3 mata tawhito hei whakawātea mokowā kōpae kākano. Kāore e taea te wete.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Mukua ngā kōnae pātengi raraunga MongoDB 3 mata hei whakawātea mokowā kōpae? Kua heke kē ngā raraunga ki FerretDB me te pūnaha kōnae. Kāore e taea te wete.

feature-views-calendar-desc: Te maramataka me te maramataka mō ngā papa maha.

feature-views-scrum-desc: Ngā mahi hua e tārewa ana, ngā wāmahi poto, te pūrongo wāmahi me te tere mahi.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Te mahi e toe ana, te mahi kua oti, te rerenga whakaemi, te wā huringa me te wā mai i te tono ki te otinga, te nui o ngā mahi kua oti, te roanga kua tatari ngā mahi, ngā ārai, Monte Carlo me ērā atu inenga rerenga.

card-field-visibility-desc: Ngā āpure i Ngā tautuhinga papa / Kāri ka taea e ngā papa te whakaatu. cards-loading-auto: Aunoa (mangere mō ngā papa nui anake)
cards-loading-description: Ka uta a WeKan i ngā kāri papa aunoa: ka uta tētahi papa nui (kei runga ake i te paepae rahinga) i ngā kāri e kitea ana i taua wā anake (panuku mutunga-kore), me tētahi kaute ora, kia tere tonu, kia iti ake hoki te pūmahara me te hōkaiipurangi; ka uta ngā papa iti ake i ia kāri mō te wheako māmā rawa, whai āheinga katoa. Kāore he mea hei whirihora. Ka taea tonu e ngā kaiwhakahaere te whakahau i tētahi aratau mā ngā taurangi taiao CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) me CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: He whakamātau te utanga kāri mangere: he tika ngā kaute kāri me ngā tepe WIP, engari ko ngā tirohanga Maramataka/Tūtohi/Gantt me te tīpakonga-maha ka whakaata i ngā kāri kua uta noa iho. Utaina anō ngā papa tuwhera i muri i te huri i tēnei.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakaaturia ngā hono katoa (ngā hono markdown pēnei i [label](url) me ngā tūtohu HTML mata <a href>) hei kuputuhi noa kāore e taea te pāwhiri i ia āpure kuputuhi whai rawa (ngā taitara papa me te kāri, ngā whakaahuatanga, ngā tākupu, ngā rārangi arowhai, aha atu). Ka ārai tēnei i ngā hono pāwhiri whakapohehe. Kua weto taunoatia, nō reira ka taea tonu te pāwhiri i ngā hono.
always-show-code-as-text: Whakaatu waehere katoa hei kuputuhi noa i ngā wā katoa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore rawa te kuputuhi whai rawa e tāhuatia hei markdown, hei HTML rānei: ka whakaaturia te pūtake katoa hei kuputuhi noa i ia āpure kuputuhi whai rawa (ngā taitara papa me te kāri, ngā whakaahuatanga, ngā tākupu, ngā rārangi arowhai, aha atu). Ka whakakite tēnei i te ihirangi huna — ngā tākupu HTML (<!-- -->), te ūnga o ngā hono markdown, JavaScript me ētahi atu waehere — kia kitea te waehere katoa, kia kore e taea te pāwhiri, kia kore hoki e rere. Kua weto taunoatia, nō reira ka tāhuatia noa te markdown.
disable-all-import-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakawetohia ngā āheinga kawemai katoa: te kawemai papa mai i WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea me Forgejo, me te tārua papa hoki. Ka huna ngā kōwhiringa tahua kawemai, ā, ka whakahē te tūmau i ia tono kawemai. Kua weto taunoatia.
import-max-megabytes-description: Te kōnae rahi rawa ka whakaaetia e te whārangi Kawemai, i ngā megapai. Ki te wātea, kāore he tepe: ka āhei te kōnae kia rahi pērā i te wāhi wātea o te kōpae e taea ai te kawemai te whakaoti. Ka tuhia ia tukuatu ki te kōpae o te tūmau i ia wāhanga, ā, ka whakakāhoretia he kawemai ka whakakī i te kōpae.
import-disk-full: Kāore e rawaka te wāhi wātea o te kōpae i te tūmau mō tēnei kawemai.
import-upload-not-found: Kua kore te kōnae i tukuatuhia i reira. Tīpakohia anō.
import-upload-failed: Kāore i taea te tukuatu i te kōnae.
disable-all-export-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakawetohia ngā āheinga kaweake katoa: te kaweake papa hei WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, ki NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo rānei, me te kaweake āpitihanga takitahi. Ka huna ngā kōwhiringa tahua kaweake, ā, ka whakahē te tūmau i ia tono kaweake. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-import-avatars-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore rawa ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi (ngā pikitia kōtaha kaiwhakamahi) e kawemai. Ka pā tēnei ki te kawemai WeKan JSON, te kawemai Trello me te tukutahi whakaahua kaiwhakamahi mai i ngā kaiwhakarato tuakiri waho i te takiuru (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Ka kawemai tonu ngā ingoa me ētahi atu raraunga; ko ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi anake ka pekea. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-export-avatars-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore rawa ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi (ngā pikitia kōtaha kaiwhakamahi) e whakaurua ina kaweake papa (kaweake WeKan JSON me CSV). Ka kaweake tonu ngā ingoa kaiwhakamahi me ētahi atu raraunga; ko ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi anake ka whakarērea. Kua weto taunoatia.
anonymize-import-users-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakakapi te kawemai papa WeKan JSON i te ingoa kaiwhakamahi, te ingoa katoa me ngā pūmatua tuatahi o ia kaiwhakamahi kawemai ki ngā puriwāhi tatau (user1, user2, ...), ka whakarērea tōna whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, ā, ka tuhi anō i ngā whakahuatanga @username (me ngā āpure requested-by / assigned-by) i roto i te ihirangi kāri me te tākupu kawemai. Kāore he tuakiri kaiwhakamahi tūturu nō te papa pūtake e penapenahia. Ka whai te kupu `user` i te reo o te tangata e kawemai ana. Kua weto taunoatia.
anonymize-export-users-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakakapi te kaweake papa i te ingoa kaiwhakamahi, te ingoa katoa me ngā pūmatua tuatahi o ia kaiwhakamahi kaweake ki ngā puriwāhi tatau (user1, user2, ...), ka whakarērea tōna whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, ā, ka tuhi anō i ngā whakahuatanga @username (me ngā āpure requested-by / assigned-by) i roto i te ihirangi kāri me te tākupu. Kāore he tuakiri kaiwhakamahi tūturu i te kōnae kaweake. Ka whai te kupu `user` i te reo o te tangata e kaweake ana. Kua weto taunoatia.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ina whakahohea, ka whakakapi te kaweake papa i te ingoa kaiwhakamahi, te ingoa katoa me ngā pūmatua tuatahi o ia kaiwhakamahi kaweake ki ngā puriwāhi tatau (user1, user2, ...), ka whakarērea tōna whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, ā, ka tuhi anō i ngā whakahuatanga @username (me ngā āpure requested-by / assigned-by) i roto i te ihirangi kāri me te tākupu. Kāore he tuakiri kaiwhakamahi tūturu i te kōnae kaweake. Ka whai te kupu `user` i te reo o te tangata e kaweake ana. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-activities-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore rawa ngā tāurunga whāngai-mahi e tuhia, e whakaaturia rānei ki hea (te paetaha papa me te ripa mahi kāri). Kāore he hītori mō wai i mahi i te aha e puritia. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-notifications-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore a WeKan e tuku whakamōhiotanga aroturuki (i-roto-taupānga, īmēra, ratonga kē rānei) mō tētahi mahi. Ka taea tonu te tuhi mahi (ki te kore hoki e monokia i runga ake); ko ngā whakamōhiotanga anake ka pēhia. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-watch-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakawetohia te āheinga aroturuki — kāore e taea e ngā kaiwhakamahi te ohauru ki ngā papa, rārangi, kāri rānei hei whiwhi whakamōhiotanga, ā, ka whakahēngia ia whakamātau ki te huri taumata aroturuki. Kua weto taunoatia.
backup-description: Pūruatia ngā Āpitihanga, ngā Whakaahua Kaiwhakamahi me/rānei ngā Raraunga (ngā kohinga ā-kuputuhi katoa ehara i te āpitihanga, i te whakaahua kaiwhakamahi rānei). Ka roma hāngai te .zip ki te putunga kua tīpakohia — kāore he kōnae rangitahi — hei backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, me te YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars me /data kei roto. Ka whakamahi ngā putunga kapua (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) i ngā taipitopito tuakiri kua whirihoratia ki ō rātou ripa putunga.
backup-scope-description: Te taupānga katoa, tētahi Whakahaere rānei. Kei roto i te tārua pūrua a tētahi Whakahaere ōna papa me ngā mea katoa kei runga, tae atu ki ngā āpitihanga o aua papa — engari kāore he pūkete kaiwhakamahi, he tautuhinga taupānga rānei, nā te mea ka tiria ēnā e ia Whakahaere. Ko te whakaora i te tārua pūrua a tētahi Whakahaere ka tuhi anake ki ngā papa nā taua Whakahaere.
theme-override-all-tenants: Whakakapi e pā ana ki ngā kairīhi katoa
continuous-backup-description: Ka roma ia huringa o te pātengi raraunga, ngā āpitihanga, ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi me ngā rangitaki ki tētahi whaiaronga i roto i ētahi hēkona, kia taea ai te whakaora ki tētahi wā. Ka mahi tahi me te tārua pūrua kua whakaritea, e hanga ana i ngā pūranga katoa.
continuous-backup-enabled: Whakahaerehia te tārua pūrua haere tonu ki tēnei tūmau
continuous-backup-target: Whaiaronga ūnga (ara pūmau, ki tētahi atu kōpae, tētahi putunga tiritahi whatunga, tētahi whakairinga rclone rānei)
wekan-data-no-database: Kāore i kitea he pātengi raraunga WeKan ka taea te pānui.
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Ngā whārangi SQLite (ngā whārangi kua huri i ia wā kua whakaritea)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Kāore he pūkaha pātengi raraunga e taea te whakahaere ki tēnei tūmau
continuous-backup-sqlite-interval: Wā i waenga i ngā mahi SQLite (hēkona)
continuous-backup-file-scan: Matawai anō i ngā kōnae katoa (hēkona)
continuous-backup-base-every: He tārua taketake hou i ia (hāora)
continuous-backup-key-file: Kōnae kī whakamuna (ara pūmau kei waho i te whaiaronga ūnga; 64 pūāhua hautekaumāono, he kīanga kupuhipa rānei e 16 neke atu ngā pūāhua). Puritia tētahi tārua: ki te kore taua kōnae, kāore e taea te whakaora i te tārua pūrua.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Kāore he wāhi (ko te whaiaronga ūnga anake)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Kōpaki i roto i te ipu rokiroki
continuous-backup-fetched: Kua tīkina mai ngā kōnae i te kapua
continuous-backup-restore-to: Whakaora ki (te rā me te wā)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Kōnae pātengi raraunga SQLite (ka hangaia ki te taha o te tārua pūrua, kāore rawa e tuhi ki runga i te kōnae e whakamahia ana)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Whakamahia te pātengi raraunga SQLite kua hangaia anō i te tīmatanga anō e whai ake nei (ka puritia te pātengi raraunga ka whakakapia)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Whakaorangia te whakatupuranga kua kōwhiria ki te wā kua kōwhiria? Ka whakatārewatia te tārua pūrua haere tonu i te wā o te whakaora.
continuous-backup-saved: Kua tiakina ngā tautuhinga tārua pūrua haere tonu
backup-restore-select-first: Tīpakohia tuatahitia tētahi tārua pūrua mai i te rārangi.
backup-restore-confirm: Whakaorangia te tārua pūrua kua tīpakohia? Ka tuhia ngā āpitihanga/whakaahua kaiwhakamahi ki te pūnaha kōnae, me ngā raraunga ki te pātengi raraunga, e ai ki te aratau kua kōwhiria.
gcs-key-filename-description: Kōwhiringa: ara ki tētahi kōnae kī JSON pūkete ratonga i te tūmau.
gcs-credentials-description: Kōwhiringa: whakapirihia te kī JSON pūkete ratonga. Waiho kia pātea hei whakamahi i te kōnae kī, i ngā taipitopito tuakiri taunoa rānei.
gcs-permissions-note: Hoatu ki te pūkete ratonga a WeKan te urunga pānui/tuhi ki te pākete: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → tō pākete → Permissions → Grant access. Ki "New principals", whakapirihia te īmēra pūkete ratonga — te uara "client_email" mai i tō kī JSON — kātahi kōwhiria te tūnga "Storage Object Admin", ka Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Waiho kia pātea hei pupuri i te uara o nāianei.
azure-account-name-description: Te ingoa o tō pūkete Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Te ipu blob hei penapena kōnae.
gcs-project-id-description: Te id o tō kaupapa Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Te ingoa o te pākete Cloud Storage hei penapena kōnae.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: waiho kia pātea (ka whakamahi i te pito rohe). Hototahi-S3: te Endpoint URL mai i tō papatohu MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → tō pākete → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → tō ingoa pākete (Create bucket → Bucket name rānei).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → tō kaiwhakamahi → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → kōwhiria te take whakamahi 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Ka whakaaturia hei 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Ko taua mata anō o te Access key ID; kotahi anake te whakaaturanga o 'Secret access key' ina hangaia te kī — tāruatia i taua wā (Download .csv rānei).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tō pūkete → te ingoa i runga rawa (kei raro hoki i Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tō pūkete → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tō pūkete → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tō pūkete → Data storage → Containers → tō ipu (+ Container rānei hei hanga).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → te kaiwhiri kaupapa i runga rawa → te ID o tō kaupapa (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → tō ingoa pākete (Create rānei hei hanga).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Ara i te tūmau WeKan ki te kōnae kī JSON pūkete ratonga kua tikiake (i hangaia ki raro). Whakamahia tēnei, whakapirihia RĀNEI te JSON ki te āpure i raro.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → tō pūkete ratonga → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (ka tikiake i te kōnae). Whakapirihia ōna ihirangi ki konei, tiakina rānei te kōnae ka tautuhi i tōna ara i runga.
cloud-secret-set: (kua tiakina — waiho kia pātea hei pupuri)
cloud-settings-save-failed: I rahua te tiaki i ngā tautuhinga putunga
cloud-settings-desc: Mā WeKan i Weddy, ka tuku te Cloud Panel i ngā rohe WeKan maha mai i te tūmau kotahi, kei ia rohe ōna ake raraunga. Kei te rohe Cloud Panel, ka whakahaere te SuperAdmin i ngā rohe me CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Mō te SuperAdmin anake te Cloud Panel, kei te rohe Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Mā te kī API CloudFlare, ka whiwhi te rohe, kei tō pūkete CloudFlare tōna zone, i tētahi rekoata DNS takawaenga me tētahi tiwhikete CloudFlare Origin. Ka whiwhi ētahi atu rohe i tētahi tiwhikete Let's Encrypt. Ka tiakina te kī ki te tūmau, ā, kore rawa e whakaaturia anō.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Kua tiakina tētahi kī API CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Kāore he kī API CloudFlare i tiakina: ka whiwhi ia rohe i tētahi tiwhikete Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Neke āpitihanga ki Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Neke āpitihanga ki Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Whakamahia MongoDB GridFS mō te putunga kōnae
migration-pausing: E whakatā ana i ngā hekenga...
migration-stopping: E whakamutu ana i ngā hekenga...
migration-pause-failed: I rahua te whakatā i ngā hekenga
migration-paused: I angitu te whakatā i ngā hekenga
migration-start-failed: I rahua te tīmata i ngā hekenga
migration-started: I angitu te tīmata i ngā hekenga
migration-not-needed: Kāore he hekenga e hiahiatia ana
migration-stop-confirm: E tino hiahia ana koe ki te whakamutu i ngā hekenga katoa?
migration-stop-failed: I rahua te whakamutu i ngā hekenga
migration-stopped: I angitu te whakamutu i ngā hekenga
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Kia kitea ai ngā āpitihanga me ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, nekehia mai i CollectionFS ki tētahi atu Putunga.
s3-access-key-description: Kī urunga AWS S3 mō te whakamotuhēhēnga
s3-bucket-description: Ingoa peere S3 hei rokiroki kōnae
s3-enabled-description: Whakamahia AWS S3, MinIO rānei mō te putunga kōnae
s3-endpoint-description: URL pito S3 (hei tauira, s3.amazonaws.com, minio.example.com rānei)
s3-port-description: Tau tauranga o te pito S3
s3-secret-key-description: Kī muna AWS S3 mō te whakamotuhēhēnga
s3-settings-save-failed: I rahua te tiaki i ngā tautuhinga S3
s3-settings-saved: Kua angitu te tiaki i ngā tautuhinga S3
s3-ssl-enabled-description: Whakamahia SSL/TLS mō ngā hononga S3
writable-path-description: Ara whaiaronga pūtake mō te putunga kōnae
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Ka mahi i ngā arowhai me ngā whakatika whānui mō te tapatahi raraunga papa, tae atu ki te raupapa rārangi, ngā tūranga kāri me te hanganga kauhanga.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Ka muku haumaru i ngā rārangi tārite pātea. Ka tango anake i ngā rārangi kāore he kāri, Ā, he rārangi anō he taitara ōrite tōna kei roto he kāri.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Ka kimi, ka whakaora hoki i ngā kāri me ngā rārangi kua ngaro te swimlaneId, te listId rānei. Ka waihanga i tētahi kauhanga 'Ngā Kāri Ngaro' kia kitea anō ngā tūemi ngaro katoa.
restore-all-archived-migration: Whakaora i ngā Mea Pūranga Katoa
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Ka whakaora i ngā kauhanga, rārangi me ngā kāri kua pūrangatia katoa. Ka whakatika aunoa i tētahi swimlaneId, listId rānei kua ngaro kia kitea ngā tūemi.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Ka tautohu, ka whakatika hoki i ngā rārangi ngaro, pirau rānei i te hanganga papa.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Ka whakahou i ngā URL whakaahua kaiwhakamahi o ngā mema papa kia whakamahi i te pūnaha putunga tika, ka whakatika hoki i ngā tohutoro whakaahua kaiwhakamahi pakaru.
fix-all-file-urls-migration: Whakatika i ngā URL Kōnae Katoa
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Ka whakahou i ngā URL āpitihanga kōnae katoa i tēnei papa kia whakamahi i te pūnaha putunga tika, ka whakatika hoki i ngā tohutoro kōnae pakaru.
migration-successful: I angitu te otinga o te hekenga
migrations-admin-only: Ko ngā kaiwhakahaere papa anake ka taea te whakahaere hekenga
migrations-description: Whakahaerehia ngā arowhai me ngā whakatika tapatahi raraunga mō tēnei papa. Ka taea te whakahaere takitahi i ia hekenga.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Ka mahi tēnei i tētahi hekenga whānui hei arowhai, hei whakatika hoki i te tapatahi raraunga papa. Ka roa pea mō ētahi wā poto. Haere tonu?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Ka tahuri tuatahi tēnei i ngā rārangi tiritahi katoa hei rārangi mō ia kauhanga, kātahi ka muku i ngā rārangi pātea he rārangi tārite tō rātou, he taitara ōrite, he kāri kei roto. Ko ngā rārangi pātea tino tuarua anake ka tangohia. Haere tonu?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Ka waihanga tēnei i tētahi kauhanga 'Ngā Kāri Ngaro', ka whakaora hoki i ngā kāri me ngā rārangi katoa kua ngaro te swimlaneId, te listId rānei. Ka pā anake tēnei ki ngā tūemi kāore i pūrangatia. Haere tonu?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Ka whakaora tēnei i ngā kauhanga, rārangi me ngā kāri KATOA kua pūrangatia, kia kitea anō. Ka whakatika aunoa i ngā tūemi kua ngaro ngā ID. Kāore e ngāwari te wete i tēnei. Haere tonu?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Ka tautohu, ka whakatika hoki tēnei i ngā rārangi ngaro, pirau rānei i te hanganga papa. Haere tonu?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Ka whakahou tēnei i ngā URL whakaahua kaiwhakamahi o ngā mema papa kia whakamahi i te pūnaha putunga tika. Haere tonu?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Ka whakahou tēnei i ngā URL āpitihanga kōnae katoa i tēnei papa kia whakamahi i te pūnaha putunga tika. Haere tonu?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Kāore he kauhanga, rārangi, kāri ngaro rānei hei whakaora
migration-progress-title: Kei te Haere te Hekenga Papa
migration-progress-note: Tēnā tatari i a mātou e heke ana i tō papa ki te hanganga hōu rawa...
step-scan-users: E arowhai ana i ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi o ngā mema papa
step-scan-files: E arowhai ana i ngā āpitihanga kōnae papa
step-fix-file-urls: E whakatika ana i ngā URL kōnae
conversion-info-text: Kotahi te wā e mahia ai tēnei tahuritanga mō ia papa, ā, ka whakapai ake i te mahinga. Ka taea tonu te whakamahi noa i te papa.

sync-recovery-description: Ngā pūrongo tukutahi i puritia mai i ngā rā 30 kua pahure. Rapua mā te ID papa, rārangi rānei. Kei te haere tonu pea tētahi whakahaerenga kāore anō kia oti, kua haukotia rānei. Tāmata kia taki anō; kāore e taea e ēnei pūrongo te haere tonu, te wetewete rānei i ngā panonitanga.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Kāore e taea te pānui i ngā tātaritanga tukutahi. Tirohia te urunga kaiwhakahaere me te wāteatanga o te tūmau.
sync-estimate-field: Āpure whakatau tata Jira kua honoa
sync-estimate-field-hint: Tīpakohia he āpure tau whai ID āpure Jira me te wae whakatau tata, i hangaia e tētahi kawemai Jira kua honoa. Ka arotakengia ngā panonitanga ā-rohe hei papā. Ka waiho ngā uara pūtake e ngaro ana; mā tētahi null mārama e muku te uara kua honoa.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab: Te āpure whakatau tata i tēnei papa
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Ka tuhia te taumaha, te whakatau tata wā rānei a GitLab ki te āpure tau ka kōwhiria e koe. Ka arotakengia ngā panonitanga ā-rohe hei papā; mā tētahi take kāore ōna taumaha e muku te uara kua honoa.
email-recovery-description: Kotahi te rārangi mō ia kaiwhiwhi. Rapua mā te ID kaiwhakamahi. Kāore ngā ihirangi karere me ngā āpure īmēra o te kaiwhiwhi e whakaaturia. Mā te whakatā e pupuri ngā karere o nāianei me ērā ka tae mai; mā te haere tonu e whakamātau anō te tuku i ngā karere kei te rārangi tatari ināianei. Mā te whakakore e muku ngā karere kua uru ki te rārangi tae noa ki te wā o te tono. Mēnā kei te haere tonu te tuku, whakamātau anō ā muri tata nei. Kāore e taea te whakahoki mai i tētahi karere kua tīmata kē te tuku, ā, tērā pea ka tukuna anō he karere kāore i te mōhiotia te putanga o tōna tukunga. Ka noho ngā rahunga pūmau me ngā karere kua eke ki te tepe whakamātau hei arotake. Mā te whakamātau anō i ngā karere i rahua e tīmata he huringa whakamātau hou, ā, ka mau tonu te whakatā kua whakaritea.

email-recovery-failed: Kāore i taea te whakaū i te mahi. Tāmatahia te rārangi, ka whakamātau anō i taua mahi mēnā e hiahiatia ana.

email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Whakakore i ngā karere katoa kei te rārangi tatari ināianei mō tēnei kaiwhiwhi? Ka mukua ō rātou ihirangi, ā, kāore e taea te whakaora. Ka puritia ngā karere hou i hangaia i muri i tēnei tono.

sync-planning-fields: Wā mahi poto me ngā tukunga
sync-planning-hint: Ka tukutahia te wā mahi poto me ngā tukunga mēnā kua whakahohea te Scrum i tēnei papa anake. Ka waihangatia he wā mahi poto, he tukunga rānei e ngaro ana i tēnei papa, me ngā rā nā te pūtake i homai. Ka whakahāngaitia tētahi mea kei reira kē mā tōna ID pūtake i te tuatahi, kātahi mā te ingoa. Ka mau tonu te panonitanga whakamahere ā-rohe kia panonitia rā anō e te pūtake te whakamahere o taua mahi. E kore te tukutahi tuatahi e tango i te whakamahere.

rule-email-recovery-description: Arotakengia ngā whakamātau tuku īmēra a ngā ture kua tuhia. Kei te tuku tonu pea ngā whakamātau kāore anō kia whakaūngia, kua haukotia rānei. Whakatuwherahia tētahi mā te "Arotake" kia tukua anō, kia tohua kua tukuna, kia whakakorehia rānei.
rule-email-recovery-sent: Kua whakaaetia e te tūmau īmēra
rule-email-recovery-invalid: He muhu ngā raraunga whakamārama o te whakamātau
rule-email-recovery-empty: Kāore he whakamātau tuku īmēra a ngā ture e hāngai ana ki tēnei rapunga.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Kāore i taea te uta i ngā ngana īmēra a ngā ture. Tāmata hei ngana anō.
rule-email-recovery-dropped: Kua whakakorea te tuku e tētahi kaiwhakahaere
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: E kore rawa a WeKan e tuku anō aunoa i tētahi īmēra kāore anō kia whakaūngia. Ka tukuna anō ki ngā kaiwhiwhi kāore anō kia whakaūngia anake. Tohua kua tukuna mēnā e mōhio ana koe kua tae atu, whakakorea rānei te tuku.

rule-email-legacy-heading: Ngā īmēra ture e tatari ana kia arotakengia
rule-email-legacy-description: I whakaritea ēnei īmēra ture e tētahi putanga tawhito o WeKan kāore i tuhi i te pūtakenga mai o ngā ihirangi, nō reira e kore a WeKan e tuku aunoa. Tirohia mēnā kei te kaituhi o te ture tonu te whakaaetanga uru, kātahi ka hono anō i te īmēra kia whakaritea anō mai i te āhua o te kāri ināianei, whakarērea rānei.

rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Kāore i taea te uta i ngā īmēra ture e tatari ana kia arotakengia. Tāmatahia te whārangi hei ngana anō.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Kāore te kaituhi o te ture e whai whakaaetanga uru ki tēnei kāri ināianei, kua rerekē rānei te ture, nō reira kāore e taea te hono anō. Ka taea e koe te whakarere i te īmēra.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Kua rerekē te hohenga i whakaoho i tēnei īmēra, nō reira kāore e taea te hono anō. Ka taea e koe te whakarere i te īmēra.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kāore te kāri i ahu mai ai tēnei īmēra e wātea ana ināianei, nō reira kāore e taea te hono anō. Ka taea e koe te whakarere i te īmēra.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Kāore te whakahaerenga o te ture i whakarite i tēnei īmēra e tiakina ana ināianei, nō reira kāore e taea te hono anō. Ka taea e koe te whakarere i te īmēra.

rule-email-legacy-failed: Kāore i taea te whakaoti i tēnei hohenga. Tāmatahia te whārangi, ka ngana anō.

stuck-sync-operation-description: I mutu ia o ēnei mahi List Sync kua tiakina i waenganui, ā, kāore e taea te whakaoti, nā te mea kua tangohia, kua hangaia anōtia, kua whirihora anōtia rānei tōna rārangi, kua ngaro rānei te urunga tuhi o te kaiwhakamahi nāna i tīmata. I te wā e tārewa ana tētahi, kāore e taea e taua rārangi te tukutahi. Whakakorea kia taea anō e te rārangi te tukutahi: ka noho ngā panonitanga kua whakahāngaitia kē, kāore rawa e tuhia ngā panonitanga kua tiakina e toe ana, ā, ka whakatairite anō te tukutahi e whai ake ana i te rārangi ki tōna pūtake.

interrupted-import-heading: Ngā kawemai papa i mutu i mua i te otinga
interrupted-import-description: I mutu ia o ēnei kawemai papa i waenganui - i tīmata anō te tūmau, i rahua rānei te kawemai - ā, i waiho he papa hāwhe. Kāore e taea te haere tonu i tētahi kawemai, nā te mea kāore tōna kōnae pūtake e puritia. Puritia te papa kia pērā tonu, whakakorea rānei ka kawemai anō i te kōnae. Mā te whakakore ka tangohia te papa i hangaia e tēnei kawemai me ngā mea katoa kei runga, tae atu ki ngā mea i tāpiritia mai i taua wā.

interrupted-import-state-discarding: Kei te whakakorea; whakakorea anō kia oti

history-request-hint: Mā te whakamātau anō ka tukuna anō taua tono tonu, nō reira e kore rawa e taea te whakakore i tētahi panonitanga tuarua.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Kua mutu te wetewete, te mahi anō, te whakaora rānei i ngā panonitanga Scrum nā tētahi taupatupatu. Kua aukatia ngā whakatikatika Scrum ki tēnei papa kia whakatauria rā anō te taupatupatu.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Kua tuhia __applied__ o ngā panonitanga __total__, kāore __pending__ i tuhia, ā, kua panonitia __conflicted__ e tētahi atu mai i taua wā.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Mā te whakahoki e whakahoki ngā pūkete kua panonitia ki ō rātou āhua o mua; ka wātea tēnei mēnā kāore tētahi atu i panoni i aua pūkete mai i taua wā. Mā te pupuri i te papa pēnei tonu e tango te mahi kua mutu, kāore hoki e panoni i tētahi pūkete. Ahakoa te kōwhiringa, ka tuhia ki te Paewhiri Kaiwhakahaere, Ngā Raru, Whakaora.
scrum-history-checkpoint-rollback: Whakahokia ki te āhua o mua
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Puritia ngā pūkete katoa ki ō rātou āhua o nāianei, tae atu ki ngā panonitanga kua tuhia kētia e te mahi kua mutu?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Ka taea e tētahi kaiwhakahaere papa te whakahoki ki te āhua o mua, te pupuri rānei i te papa pēnei tonu.
login-setting-clear-secret: Tangohia te uara kua tiakina ki te papatohu kaiwhakahaere
login-setting-after-restart: Ka mana i muri i te tīmata anō o WeKan
login-setting-env-only: Mā te taiao tūmau anake ēnei e tautuhi. Ka whakaaturia ki konei hei pānui-anake.
email-to-card-description: Ka tukuna he īmēra ki te wāhitau o tō papa, ka huri hei kāri i taua papa.
email-to-card-webhook: URL webhook urunga a te kaiwhakarato mēra (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark, he whakawhiti MIME mata rānei)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Kua tiakina - waiho kia wātea kia mau tonu
email-to-card-clear-secret: Tangohia te muna webhook kua tiakina
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Ngā pouaka mēra IMAP hei pānui
email-to-card-imap-after: Ka mutu te pānui i tētahi īmēra
email-to-card-sandstorm-address: Te wāhitau īmēra o tēnei grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Te papa ka tae atu ngā īmēra ki tēnei grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Kore - ko ngā īmēra anake he tohu papa kei te kaupapa
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Tuhia tēnei ki te kaupapa kia tae ki tēnei papa hei a koe anō:
email-to-card-parts: Ngā wāhanga o te īmēra hei whakamahi
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Waiho ngā karere o mua kua whakahuatia
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Rārangi kaituku ki runga o te whakaahuatanga
email-to-card-your-address: Tō wāhitau īmēra mō tēnei papa
email-to-card-address-private: Kia tūmataiti: ko te tangata kei a ia, ka taea te tāpiri kāri hei a koe.
email-to-card-new-address: Wāhitau hou (ka mutu te mahi o te mea tawhito)
email-to-card-member-enabled: Kei te mahi ōku wāhitau papa
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Kāore anō te whiwhi īmēra kia whakaritea i te Papatohu Kaiwhakahaere.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Kāore anō tētahi kaiwhakahaere papa kia whakakā i te īmēra mō tēnei papa.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Kua whakawetohia e koe ō wāhitau papa i ngā Tautuhinga Mema.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Kāore anō te grain kia whiwhi i tōna wāhitau īmēra. Utaina anōtia te whārangi.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Me whai urunga tuhi koe ki tēnei papa.
inbound-domain-invalid: Ehara tērā i te ingoa rohe tika.
inbound-domain-required: Hoatu te rohe o ngā wāhitau papa.
inbound-account-invalid: Me whai ingoa tūmau tika tētahi pouaka mēra IMAP.
feature-views-email-desc: Ko te papa hei pouaka īmēra: ko te rārangi īmēra te Pouaka whakauru, ko ngā rārangi ngā kōpaki, ko ngā tapanga ngā tapanga, ā, ka tuhi, ka whakautu ngā mema i ngā īmēra mai i te wāhitau o te papa.
email-view-not-receiving: Kāore anō tēnei papa e whiwhi īmēra. Whakakāngia i ngā Tautuhinga pānui o te papa → Īmēra ki te kāri.
email-view-invalid-address: Ko tētahi o ngā wāhitau ehara i te wāhitau īmēra tika.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Kia 20 ngā kaiwhiwhi i te nuinga mō ia karere.
email-view-too-many: He nui rawa ngā īmēra i tukuna i te hāora kua hipa. Ngana anō ā muri ake.
email-view-no-list: Me whai rārangi te papa mō te īmēra.
email-view-send-failed: Kāore i taea te tuku i te īmēra.
feature-views-chat-desc: Ko te papa hei wāhi kōrerorero: ngā wāhi mahi, ngā papa, ngā ara, ngā rārangi me ngā kāri hei rākau hongere, ko te kāri kei waenganui, ā, ko ōna kōrero hei karere kōrerorero.
chat-view-message-cards: Whakaaturia ngā kāri he karere anake
chat-view-pick-card: Kōwhiria he kāri i ngā hongere kia kitea ki konei.
chat-view-no-messages: Kāore anō he karere. Tuhia te tuatahi.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Ko ngā kāri ōrite i ētahi huinga tīwae whai ingoa - mā te otinga, te matua, te tohu taumata, tētahi atu mea rānei - ka nekehia i waenga i ngā tīwae mā te tō.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Tahua papa → Ka marohi ngā Ture i ngā ture mai i ngā mea e mahia ana ā-ringa e te tangata i ia wā.
feature-board-summary-desc: Tahua papa → Ka whakaatu te Whakarāpopototanga i ngā mahi a ia tangata i te papa i te rā, i te wiki whakamutunga rānei, me ngā mea kua tōmuri.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Tahua papa → Ka whakaatu a Mai i tō toronga whakamutunga i ngā mea i hurihia e ētahi atu i te papa.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ka mārama te rapu whānui ki ngā kīanga māmā pērā i "aku kāri kua tōmuri".
column-sets-empty: Kāore anō he huinga tīwae. Ka taea e tētahi kaiwhakahaere papa te hanga: tapaina, kātahi ka tāpiri i ōna tīwae.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Te poari hei kaiaroturuki take GitHub, Gitea rānei: ngā kāri hei take, ngā tapanga me ngā pou tohu, ngā kōrero hei kōrerorero, ngā āpitihanga hei kōnae, me te hītori o te poari me te wetewete.
vcs-no-issues: Kāore he take e ōrite ana ki tēnei rapunga.
vcs-no-milestones: Kāore anō he pou tohu. Ko te tapanga he rā tika tōna he pou tohu.
vcs-no-list: Kāore he rārangi, he ara kauhoe rānei o tēnei poari mō te take.
card-qr-code-desc: Matawaia kia whakatuwheratia tēnei kāri ki tētahi waea, papa rorohiko rānei.
card-qr-code-too-long: He roa rawa te hono o tēnei kāri mō tētahi waehere QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Kāore anō he wiki. Mā te kawemai rōpū GitHub e kawe mai te wiki o tētahi pūtahi ki konei.
github-org-import: Kawemai i tētahi rōpū GitHub katoa
github-org-import-desc: Ka noho ia pūtahi o tētahi rōpū, kaiwhakamahi rānei hei papa mōna anō, ka huakina i Board View / Version Control: ōna take me ō rātou kōrero, tapanga me ngā kōnae, ōna putanga, ōna rerenga mahi GitHub Actions hei Ture, me tōna wiki.
github-org-import-token-hint: E hiahiatia ana mō ngā pūtahi tūmataiti me te tepe API teitei ake. Ka whakamahia anake i te wā e rere ana te kawemai, ā, kāore rawa e tiakina.
github-org-import-issues: Ngā take, me ngā kōrero, ngā tapanga me ngā kōnae
github-org-import-actions: Ngā rerenga mahi GitHub Actions hei Ture
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Tuhia te ingoa o tētahi rōpū, kaiwhakamahi rānei, tōna wāhitau GitHub rānei.
github-org-import-running: Kei te rere kē tētahi kawemai rōpū.
optional-apis-desc: Ngā API REST e rite ana ki te āhua o ngā API o ētahi atu pūaroturuki, kia taea ai e ā rātou taupānga me ā rātou hōtuhi te whakamahi i tēnei WeKan hei tuarongo mō rātou: ko ngā mea ka penapenahia e rātou ka rongoātia ki WeKan, ki ngā papa WeKan. Kua whakawetongia ia mea tae noa ki te tohua i konei. Kāore he mana motuhake o tētahi: ka takiuru tētahi kiritaki mā tētahi tohu API WeKan, ā, ka kite, ka panoni hoki i ngā mea anake ka taea e taua tangata te kite me te panoni i WeKan. Me whakakā te API REST o WeKan mō rātou katoa (WITH_API=true). Ko te wāhitau i raro i ia mea te mea ka whakamahia e te kiritaki hei tūmau mōna.
optional-api-trello-desc: Ka mahi ngā taupānga me ngā hōtuhi i tuhia mō te API REST o Trello (hei tauira, Trellinator) ki WeKan: ngā papa, ngā rārangi, ngā kāri, ngā tapanga, ngā mema, ngā kōrero me ngā rārangi arowhai. Ko te tohu Trello he tohu API WeKan. Ki te mukua tētahi kāri, ka pūrangatia ki WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Ka mahi ngā kiritaki o te API REST v2 o Jira ki WeKan: he papa te kaupapa (ko tōna kī te kī o te papa), he kāri te take (DEV-7), he rārangi te tūnga, ā, ka nekehia te kāri e te whakawhitinga. Ka whakaae te rapu ki te JQL māmā: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text me ORDER BY. Takiuru mā tētahi tohu API WeKan hei kupuhipa. Ki te mukua tētahi take, ka pūrangatia.
optional-api-github-desc: Ka mahi ngā kiritaki o te API REST o GitHub mō ngā take ki WeKan: he papa te pūranga waehere, he kāri te take, me ngā tapanga, ngā pou tohu (he tapanga he rā tepenga), ngā kōrero, me te tuwhera, kua kati rānei pērā i Tirohanga Papa / Mana putanga. Ko te tohu he tohu API WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Ka mahi ngā kiritaki o te API REST o Gitea me Forgejo mō ngā take ki WeKan, he rite tonu ki te API hāngai ki GitHub: he papa te pūranga waehere, he kāri te take. Ko te tohu he tohu API WeKan.
bots-none: Kāore anō he bot. He kaiwhakahaere te bot i tō ake tūmau - he kaihoko AI, he mahi CI, he hōtuhi - ka tukuna e tēnei papa ngā kāri ki a ia.
bots-no-runs: Kāore he bot e mahi ana ināianei.
bots-summary: %s e mahi ana · %s e tatari ana ki a koe
bots-status-awaiting_input: E tatari ana ki a koe
r-dispatch-bot: Tukuna te kāri ki te bot
bot-not-found: Kāore taua bot i runga i tēnei papa.
bot-option-not-found: Ehara taua whakautu i tētahi i tukuna e te bot.
bot-reply-empty: Tuhia he whakautu i te tuatahi.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Kāore e taea e ngā webhook puta te tae atu ki ngā wāhitau i te whatunga ake o WeKan, kia kore ai tētahi e taea te tohu i te webhook o tētahi papa ki tētahi ratonga ā-roto. Rārangitia ki konei ngā kaihautū (host) i taua whatunga ka taea e ngā webhook te tae atu - he Node-RED, he tūmau kōrerorero - kotahi i ia rārangi, hei ingoa, hei wāhitau rānei, me tētahi tauranga kia whakaaetia ko taua tauranga anake. Kau: kāore he mea. Ko ngā kaiwhakahaere pae anake ka taea te huri i tēnei rārangi.
account-webhook-desc: Kotahi te wāhitau e whakamōhiotia ana e WeKan ina takiuru tētahi, ina hangaia rānei he pūkete hou. Kāore he mea e tukuna kia tohua rā anō tētahi takahanga i raro. Ka mauria te takahanga, te ingoa kaiwhakamahi me te wā; tohua ētahi atu āpure mēnā ka hiahiatia e te kaiwhiwhi.
account-webhook-field-ip: Te wāhitau IP i ahu mai ai te takiuru
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: Ehara i te kaihautū, kāore i tiakina:
activity-recovery-cancel-older: Whakakore i ngā mea tawhito ake…
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Me whakakore ngā whakamōhiotanga katoa e tārewa ana mō ngā mahi tawhito ake i te hia rā?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: %s kua whakakorea, %s kua tukuna, %s tawhito ake e tārewa tonu ana.
vcs-synced-from: Kua tukutahitia mai i %s: whakatuwherahia, katia hoki ki reira.
vcs-synced-issue: Kua tukutahitia tēnei take: whakatuwherahia, katia hoki ki tōna pūaroturuki.
sync-issue-details: Ngā tākupu, ngā tapanga, te tūnga me ngā kōnae
sync-write-back: Tuhia anō ngā panonitanga ki GitLab: taitara, whakaahuatanga, ngā tākupu, te kati me te whakatuwhera anō
sync-write-back-error: I rahua te tuhi anō ki GitLab
email-bounces-description: Ko tā WeKan mahi ki ngā īmēra ka hoki mai: he wāhitau i hē te patopato, he pouaka īmēra kī, he whakautu kāore i te tari, he amuamu pāme. He mahi motuhake tō ia momo, ka mahia ina hoki mai i te maha o ngā wā.
email-bounces-enabled: Whakahaere i ngā īmēra hoki mai i WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Kāti te tuku īmēra ki te wāhitau
email-bounces-action-notify-inviter: Whakamōhio atu ki te tangata nāna i pōwhiri
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Kāore te wāhitau i te tīari: he hapa patopato, he pūkete kua mukua, he rohe tē mōhiotia.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Kāore anō kia tukuna: kua kī te pouaka, kei te pukumahi te tūmau. Mā te maha anake i te rārangi e whai tikanga ai.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Ngā whakautu kāore i te tari, hararei, pūnaha tīkiti rānei. I tukuna te īmēra.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: I tohua e te kaiwhiwhi te īmēra hei pāme.
email-bounces-ses-description: I Amazon SES, tukuna ngā pānui Bounce me Complaint, me tētahi ture whiwhinga mō te wāhitau e tuku ai a WeKan, ki tētahi kaupapa SNS, ā, ohauru i tēnei wāhitau ki reira mā HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Ngā ARN kaupapa SNS hei whakaae, kotahi i ia rārangi
email-bounces-stopped-only: Ko ngā wāhitau anake kāore a WeKan e tuku īmēra atu anō
email-bounces-clear-hint: Warewaretia ngā hokinga o tēnei wāhitau, ā, tukuna anō he īmēra
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Ehara tēnā i te ARN kaupapa SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Mēnā ka tuku a WeKan mā tētahi o ēnei ratonga, whakakāngia, hoatu ki te ratonga tēnei wāhitau webhook mō ōna takahanga īmēra hoki mai, amuamu pāme hoki, ā, whakapiria ki konei te kī e waitohu ai ia i aua mea, te kupuhipa rānei i whakauruhia e koe ki te wāhitau hei https://user:password@…, hei ?secret=… rānei
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Ka hiahia tētahi ratonga kua whakakāngia ki tōna kī waitohu, kupuhipa rānei.
activity-pub-enabled: Ka whakaputa ngā papa tūmatanui i ā rātou mahi kāri ki te fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Kua weto ā-taunoa. Ina whakakāngia, ka taea te whai i ia papa tūmatanui mai i Mastodon me ētahi atu tūmau fediverse hei @board-<id> i te wāhitau o tēnei WeKan, ā, ka tae ngā mahi kāri hou ki ōna kaiwhai. He pānui anake: kāore he mea ka tukuna mai e tētahi tūmau fediverse e huri i tētahi papa, ā, kāore rawa ngā papa tūmataiti e whakaputaina.
caldav-sync-desc: Whakaurua ngā rā tika o ngā kāri o tēnei papa ki tētahi maramataka - Nextcloud Calendar, tētahi maramataka CalDAV rānei. Ka hoki mai ki te kāri tētahi rā tika ka nekehia i te maramataka. Whakamahia tētahi kupuhipa taupānga, kaua ko tōu ake.
caldav-enabled: Tukutahitia ngā rā tika ki tēnei maramataka
caldav-invalid-url: Me noho te wāhitau maramataka hei wāhitau http:// hei wāhitau https:// rānei, kāore he ingoa kaiwhakamahi, kupuhipa rānei i roto.
caldav-not-linked: Tiakina tētahi wāhitau maramataka, ka whakakā ai i te tukutahi i te tuatahi.
webdav-storage-description: Rokiroki ai ngā āpitihanga ki tētahi kōpaki i tētahi tūmau WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud, tētahi atu rānei. Whakamahia tētahi kupuhipa taupānga i hangaia mō WeKan. Ka taea te whakamahi i konei tētahi tūmau kei te whatunga ake o WeKan, nā te mea ko te kaiwhakahaere pae anake e whakarite ana i tēnei wāhitau.
sqrl-desc: Kua weto i te tuatahi. Ina whakakāngia, ka tukuna e te whārangi takiuru te SQRL, ā, ka tāpiri tuatahi ngā mema i tō rātou tuakiri SQRL ki Ngā tautuhinga mema. Me noho a WeKan ki tētahi wāhitau https:// mō te SQRL.
sqrl-scan: Matawaitia te waehere ki tō taupānga SQRL, kia huakina rānei tō kiritaki SQRL ki tēnei pūrere.
sqrl-expired: Kua pau te wā o tēnei waehere SQRL. Tīmata anō.
sqrl-needs-https: Me noho a WeKan ki tētahi wāhitau https:// mō te SQRL.
sqrl-description: Takiuru mā tō tuakiri SQRL, kaua mā te kupuhipa. Tāpirihia ki konei kotahi te wā mā tō kiritaki SQRL; ka taea e koe te tango i konei ahakoa āhea.
sqrl-none: Kāore he tuakiri SQRL kua tāpirihia.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Kua monokia te takiuru SQRL mō tēnei pūkete i tō kiritaki SQRL. Whakahohea anō ki reira mā tō waehere whakaora.
sqrl-only-on: Kua rakaina e tō kiritaki SQRL tēnei pūkete ki SQRL anake: ka whakakāhoretia ngā huarahi takiuru kē katoa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Kua tino rakaina e tō kiritaki SQRL tēnei pūkete: ka whakakāhoretia te tautuhi anō i te kupuhipa me te huri īmēra.
sqrl-only: Ka takiuru tēnei pūkete mā SQRL anake.
sqrl-hardlock: Kua rakaina tēnei pūkete ki SQRL: kāore e taea te whakaora, te huri rānei mā tētahi atu huarahi.
windows-sso-failed: I rahua te takiuru Windows. Tērā pea kāore tō pūkete Windows e whakaaetia ki konei.
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: Kāore he poraka ōrite i kitea
enrollment-password-instructions: Whakaūngia tō kupuhipa kia tīmata ai te tatūnga. Mā tēnei mahi e kore koe e takiuru. Kāore e taea te whakakapi i konei i tētahi tikanga whakaū e hohe kē ana.
enrollment-setup-denied: Kāore e taea te tīmata te tatūnga. Tirohia ō taipitopito takiuru, ā, tirohia mēnā kua whakahohea kē ngā waehere whakamahi kotahi.
enrollment-code-instructions: Whakamahia ngā waehere ā-wā: SHA1, e ono ngā mati, ā, e 30 hēkona te wā i waenga. Kaua e tohatoha te kī muna. Ka mōnehu te tatūnga i muri i te rima meneti.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: Kua whakamahia kētia te waehere whakaū. I mua i te takiuru, tatari kia whakaatu te taupānga whakamotuhēhē i tētahi waehere hou.
registration-first-admin: Ka whiwhi te pūkete tuatahi o tēnei rohe i ngā whakaaetanga a te kaiwhakahaere whānui.
auth-too-many-attempts: He nui rawa ngā whakamātau takiuru. Ngana anō ā muri ake.
enrollment-setup-failed: Kāore i taea te tīmata te tatūnga.
registration-global-admin-disabled: Ka waihangatia ā-rohe ngā pūkete a ngā kaiwhakahaere whānui. Kua monokia te rēhitatanga tūmatanui.
auth-session-create-failed: Kāore i taea te waihanga i te wātū.
registration-password-unavailable: Kāore e taea te rēhita mā te kupuhipa.
expedite-limit: Kotahi anake te kāri tuwhera o te papa ka taea te Kōhukihuki i te wā kotahi.
list-policy-placeholder: Āhea e āhei ai tētahi kāri ki te uru ki tēnei rārangi, ā, āhea ka oti ki konei?
commitment-point-hint: Ka taunahatia te mahi mai i tēnei rārangi; ko ngā rārangi i mua i a ia he kōwhiringa.
person-wip-over: E __count__ ngā kāri tuwhera a __user__; ko te tepe WIP mō ia tangata ko __limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: Te kaupapahere o ia rārangi - āhea e uru ai te kāri, āhea ka oti ki reira - kei te pane o te rārangi. Ka whakakāngia mō ia papa i Ngā tautuhinga papa / Rārangi.
feature-commitment-point-desc: Te rārangi e taunahatia ai te mahi, kua tohua ki tōna pane. Ka kōwhiria mō ia papa i Ngā tautuhinga papa / Rārangi.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: E hia ngā kāri tuwhera ka puritia e te tangata kotahi ki tētahi papa; ka whakatūpato te kāri kua whakatuwheratia mō te hunga kua hipa. Ka tautuhia mō ia papa i Ngā tautuhinga papa / Rārangi.
scrum-definition-of-ready: Whakamāramatanga o te mahi kua rite
feature-standup-timer: Taima hui tū o ia rā
feature-standup-timer-desc: Te hui tū o ia rā i te tahua papa: ngā mema o te papa i te raupapa kōrapurapu, he ōrite te wā mō ia tangata. Ka whakawetohia mō ia papa i ōna Ngā tautuhinga Scrum.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Te papa whakaaro whakamuri i te tahua papa: he papa tūmataiti hou me ngā rārangi Tīmata ki te mahi, Kāti te mahi, Haere tonu te mahi me Ngā mahi hei mahi. Ka whakawetohia mō ia papa i ōna Ngā tautuhinga Scrum.
show-split-lists: Tukuna kia wehea ngā rārangi ki E mahia ana me Kua oti
list-split: Wehea ki E mahia ana me Kua oti
split-done: Kua oti i konei, e tatari ana kia tōia whakamua
feature-split-lists-desc: He rārangi kua wehea ki E mahia ana me Kua oti: ko te kāri kua tohua kua oti ki reira ka tatari, kua mōhinahina, kia tōia ki te rārangi e whai ake nei, ā, ka tatau te pane o te rārangi i ngā mea e rua. Ka whakaaetia mō ia papa i Ngā tautuhinga papa / Rārangi, kātahi ka whakakāngia i te tahua o ia rārangi.
workload-title: Taumaha mahi me te kaha mahi
workload-intro: Ngā hāora matapae me ngā piro kōrero o ngā kāri kua tautapatia ki ia tangata, ia wiki, ia wiki, ki te taha o ngā hāora kei a rātou: tō rātou wā mahi, ngā ngaronga me ngā hararei tūmatanui. Pāwhiritia tētahi wiki kia kite i ōna kāri.
workload-truncated: He nui rawa hei whakaatu i te wā kotahi: ko ngā tāngata me ngā kāri tuatahi anake e whakaaturia ana e te pūrongo. Kōwhiria kia iti iho ngā wiki, kia iti iho rānei ngā papa.
workload-legend-ok: I roto i te kaha mahi
workload-legend-under: I raro i te haurua o te kaha mahi
workload-legend-over: Neke atu i te 100 % o te kaha mahi
workload-no-cards: Kāore he kāri i tēnei wiki.
workload-allocations-intro: E hia te nui o te wā o tētahi tangata ka haere ki tētahi papa, ko ēhea tūranga rānei ka hiahiatia e tētahi papa i mua i te whakaingoatanga o tētahi.
workload-role-placeholder: Kāore anō he tangata: he tūranga
workload-invalid-estimate: Me noho te matapae i waenga i te 0 me te 10000 hāora.
feature-workload-desc: Te Taumaha mahi me te kaha mahi o te tahua kaiwhakamahi: ngā hāora matapae me ngā piro kōrero o ngā kāri o ia tangata, ia wiki, ki te taha o tō rātou wā mahi, ngā ngaronga me ngā hararei tūmatanui, me ngā tohanga ki ngā papa me ngā tūranga whakakapi.
billing-intro: Ngā papa e kaiwhakahaere ai koe: tō rātou tahua pūtea, te utu o ā rātou mahi kua pau, ka pau hoki i ngā utu ia hāora i whakaritea e koe, me ngā nama o ngā hāora kua pau. Ko ngā kaiwhakahaere papa anake ka kite i tēnei.
billing-no-boards: Ehara koe i te kaiwhakahaere o tētahi papa.
billing-over-budget: Kua neke ake i te tahua
billing-unrated: Kāore he utu ia hāora o ngā __hours__ h, ā, kāore anō kia wāriutia. Whakaritea he utu mō te papa, mō aua tāngata rānei.
billing-default-rate: Te hunga katoa atu (taunoa o te papa)
billing-nothing-to-invoice: Kua oti kē te nama ia hāora ka taea te nama.
billing-set-rate-first: Whakaritea tuatahi he utu ia hāora mō tēnei papa.
billing-due-date: Rā e tika ana te utu
feature-billing-desc: Te Tahua pūtea me te nama o te tahua kaiwhakamahi: te tahua o tētahi papa i te moni, i ngā hāora rānei, ngā utu ia hāora, te utu me te matapae o ana mahi, me ngā nama o ngā hāora ka taea te nama kua pau. Ko ngā kaiwhakahaere papa anake ka kite.
billing-include-undated: Whakaurua te wā i tuhia i mua i te puritanga o ngā rā
billing-pay-by-scanning: Utua mā te matawai ki tō taupānga pēke, taupānga utu rānei
billing-reverse-charge: Utu whakamuri: mā te kaihoko te tāke hokohoko e utu
billing-undated-included: Kei roto ngā hāora __hours__ i tuhia i mua i te puritanga o ngā rā.
time-entry-undated: I mua i te puritanga o ngā rā
billing-method-mnb: Waehere QR whakawhiti tonu o Hanekeri
billing-field-promptpay-target: Tau waea pūkoro, ID ā-motu, ID pūkoro-e rānei
billing-field-proxy: Tau waea pūkoro, UEN, ID FPS, īmēra rānei
billing-uncosted: Kāore he utu ā-hāora o ngā __hours__ h, ā, kāore i roto i te utu.
billing-bill-time: Namatia te wā ā-hāora (weto: he utu pūmau, ko ngā utu pūmau me ngā whakapaunga anake ka namatia)
billing-approve-time: Whakaaetia te wā i mua i te namatanga
billing-quote-valid-days: Ka mana ngā tātai utu mō ngā rā
billing-fees: Ngā utu pūmau me ngā utu ā-marama
billing-fees-intro: Ka namatia kotahi te pae tawhiti, te utu pūmau rānei, mai i tōna rā; ko te utu ā-marama ia marama mai i tōna rā tae noa ki tōna mutunga.
billing-nothing-to-approve: Kāore he wā e tatari ana kia whakaaetia.
billing-unapproved: E tatari ana ngā __hours__ h kia whakaaetia, ā, kāore i runga i tēnei nama.
billing-quotes-intro: Ka utua e te tātai utu te mahi e toe ana - te matapae o ia kāri tuwhera, ka tangohia te wā kua pau - me ngā utu kāore anō kia namatia.
billing-accept-sets-budget: Ka riro te tātai utu kua whakaaetia hei tahua pūtea mō te papa
workload-utilization-title: Ngā hāora ka taea te nama, ka whakatairitea ki te wā mahi o ēnei wiki
workload-no-candidates: Kāore he tangata whai i tēnei pūkenga
